Find Insuree By CHF ID.description: Looks up an insuree (FHIR Patient) by their insurance number.

List Insurees Page By Page.description: Lists insurees in pages, for a bulk sync to a registry or data warehouse.

Get Insuree By ID.description: Fetches a single insuree record by its openIMIS UUID.
Get Insuree By ID.code:
// Fetch a single insuree by UUID.
getFHIR(`Patient/${$.data.insureeUuid}/`);

Find Claims For Insuree.description: Lists the claims submitted for a given insuree.

Get Claim Response.description: Fetches the adjudication outcome (ClaimResponse) for a claim, to report back to the health facility.
Get Claim Response.code:
// Get the adjudication result for a claim.
getFHIR(`ClaimResponse/${$.data.claimUuid}/`);

Check Insuree Coverage.description: Retrieves coverage (policy) records valid on a reference date, to check eligibility.

List Families And Households.description: Lists families/households (FHIR Group), e.g. for social-protection enrolment reconciliation.

List Insurance Products.description: Lists the insurance products (InsurancePlan) configured in openIMIS.

Get Diagnosis Code System.description: Fetches the diagnosis code list, to map ICD codes from an EMR before submitting claims.
Get Diagnosis Code System.code:
// Get the diagnosis CodeSystem used on claims.
getFHIR('CodeSystem/diagnosis/');

List Policy Holders.description: Lists policy holders (FHIR Organization), e.g. employers enrolling staff in a contributory scheme.
